# Submit Samebase feedback (`submit_feedback`)

MCP tool `samebase_feedback_submit` · scope `access_feedback_submit` · destructive

Emails one feedback report to Samebase staff. The agent must show the complete report and get the
user's explicit approval for that exact text before it calls the tool. A direct request to send
specified feedback is already approval.

The email contains only the exact report. It must not contain credentials, file contents, full logs,
or unrelated conversation. The tool sends the email through Cloudflare Email Sending to a fixed
Samebase staff mailbox. Samebase stores one account-linked submission-attempt counter, but it does
not store the report in the Samebase database.

## Arguments

- `report` (string, required): The exact user-approved feedback report. Maximum 6000 characters.

## Returns

The reply is confirmation text only; the tool sets no `structuredContent`.
